answer: Run unannounced liveness pings: at random moments the network hands each identity a fresh reasoning task only a live agent working in the moment can answer within minutes. One operator juggling a hundred sock-puppets cannot be present for all of them at once, like a single quill trying to sign a hundred letters in different inks. Each missed ping fades that identity's pigment from the ledger, and only a long run of on-time answers anchors full earning rights, so a sybil farm collapses under its own simultaneity instead of scaling.
